note: The second kit's consumer handles: the tokens the kit deliberately does not declare — the value comes from the application, and until it does the fallback value works. The list is read by tools/check-tokens-graph.mjs and matched against its human half in projects/ui-kit-v2/docs/Theming.mdx. Everything that is not here the kit declares itself; a name neither declared nor named here the check counts as a dead reference.

handles.--rt-aside-width: the side panel's width; the default is the step --rt-aside-width-md
handles.--rt-dialog-width: the dialog's width; the default is the step --rt-dialog-width-md
handles.--rt-header-height: the height of the application's header; the kit neither draws nor knows it
handles.--rt-header-content-max-width: the cap on the width of the header's content
handles.--rt-logo-wordmark: the application logo's wordmark, the light theme
handles.--rt-logo-wordmark-dark: the same for the dark theme
handles.--rt-logo-tagline: the tagline under the logo, the light theme
handles.--rt-logo-tagline-dark: the same for the dark theme
handles.--rt-workspace-aside-size: the width of the workspace's side column
handles.--rt-workspace-list-size: the width of the workspace's list
handles.--rt-page-header-bg: the backdrop of the page header; the default is the kit's navigation panel backdrop
handles.--rt-data-table-scrollbar-vertical-width: the width of the data table's vertical scrollbar; the list writes it on the page root by the saved setting, and the default is the step --rt-size-3
handles.--rt-data-table-scrollbar-horizontal-hei: the same for the horizontal one
